summary.text: Jason Hennessey is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jason Hennessey ran in the 2018 Republican primary for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 22, in which Peter Hansen, Reed Panasiti and Scott Courtemanche defeated him, according to Ballotpedia.
